description:

We are looking for a hands-on public relations professional who has actually pitched reporters, developed media relationships, and helped secure meaningful earned coverage. This is an execution-focused, multi-client role with the opportunity to help shape a growing earned-media and digital PR practice. You should be able to take an approved campaign direction and independently move it from research and messaging through outreach, follow-up, and reporting.
About RR Digital

RR Digital is a digital marketing agency helping law firms grow through data-driven strategy, paid media, SEO, content, web development, and marketing technology. We are expanding how traditional public relations and digital PR work alongside those capabilities to strengthen client visibility, credibility, and authority.
About the Role
The PR Specialist will support a growing portfolio of legal, litigation, and advocacy clients, including case announcements, attorney thought leadership, public affairs, and sensitive advocacy campaigns. You will execute day-to-day earned-media work across multiple accounts while partnering with PR leadership on positioning, client priorities, and high-value opportunities.
As RR Digital develops a broader digital PR offering, you will also help plan and execute campaigns built around original research, data, relevant news, expert commentary, podcasts, newsletters, and digital publishers. You will collaborate with SEO, link-building, content, and social teams, while keeping clear distinctions between independently earned coverage, paid placements, and press release syndication.
What You'll Do

• Identify proactive opportunities from breaking news, litigation developments, public records, client milestones, and timely trends.

• Support digital PR campaigns promoting credible original research, surveys, useful resources, and data-driven stories; coordinate outreach sequencing, exclusives, and embargoes when appropriate.

• Collaborate with SEO and link-building colleagues to connect editorial opportunities with relevant content and audience goals, without compromising journalistic standards or pitching solely for links.

• Coordinate attorneys and clients for interviews, approvals, and time-sensitive journalist requests; maintain accurate calendars, status updates, and campaign records.

• Monitor and clearly distinguish independent earned coverage, wire syndication, editorial mentions and links, referral activity, and other campaign outcomes.

• Help refine repeatable processes, reporting templates, campaign intake, and cross-team workflows as the earned-media practice grows.

• Handle confidential and sensitive legal and survivor-advocacy matters with care, accuracy, sound judgment, and discretion.

Who You Are

• A resourceful publicist who enjoys finding a real story and persuading the right journalist to care about it.

• Comfortable owning the details of an account or campaign while knowing when to escalate sensitive strategic or legal questions.

• Curious, collaborative, precise, and able to work in an evolving department without waiting for perfect processes.

• Motivated by quality of placements and relationships, not just email volume, syndication counts, or vanity metrics.

title: Director of Ops & Deputy Managing Director Germany
description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need-and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. • Explorer (Level 1) - Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

title: Business Development Lead (Defense)

Rocket Communications is an enterprise UX Design company focused on designing mission-critical applications and systems. The Business Development Lead (Defense) is an integral contributor to Rocket’s growth strategy, leading the expansion of the company’s footprint across specific Department of War (DoW) branches. This is a unique role that understands the technical nuances of Rocket’s projects as well as the broader defense environment, using that knowledge to identify and capture new business opportunities.
The Business Development Lead will report directly to the Senior Vice President of Programs. They are responsible for building and maintaining positive relationships with large defense primes and government entities to steer the pipeline for continued growth, ensuring Rocket maximizes the value provided to our defense partners while maintaining a healthy and robust business development pipeline.
We are a small but fast-growing company, and your work will have a direct impact on the success of our business and team members. Our work can be challenging and complex, but our team is fun, friendly, supportive, and the work is rewarding.
About You

• You have 5+ years of proven business development, account management, or similar sales experience specifically within the defense sector.

• You maintain deep domain expertise in the Federal and Dept of War domains, including a state-of-the-market understanding of unique technologies, trends, personnel, and branch-specific technological needs.

• You establish and grow strategic relationships with Dept of War program leaders, defense industrial base primes, and other small non-traditional companies.

• You have exceptional networking skills with the ability to establish trust and new connections within the DoW and industry quickly.

• Your communication and presentation skills are strong, with a high comfort level presenting to high-level stakeholders and public speaking.

• You have an understanding and awareness of emerging trends in UX Design and Development in order to forward-think and prepare Rocket to gain more business.

• You are able to attend and network at professional events and meetings to represent Rocket and its services an average of one week per month.

title: Head of Key Accounts, Customer Success
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Key Accounts Customer Success team is responsible for the growth, optimization, stakeholder engagement, and cross‑functional program delivery of Stripe’s most important users. Key Accounts often have complex multi-layered relationships, and are among our most important co-innovation partners. The team partners closely with Sales, Paid Support, Solutions Architecture, Product, and Payments Performance to drive critical outcomes for the users.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a leader who will manage teams of CSMs focused on a portfolio of our largest Key Accounts at Stripe, driving strategic account planning, product distribution, executive engagement, and payments optimization to maximize retention, expansion, and customer lifetime value. You will hire, mentor, and scale the team, codify playbooks for platform engagement, and embed repeatable processes that balance bespoke customer needs with operational rigor.

• Lead and grow a team of senior CSMs focused on Key Accounts: hire, coach, set goals, run calibration and performance reviews, and develop playbooks and operating rhythms for a high-performing strategic CSM organization.

• Own strategic account planning and executive engagement for Key Accounts: define multi‑quarter account roadmaps, support executive business reviews, and ensure broad sponsorship.

• Set clear goals focused on product distribution and share of wallet gains that tie directly to business impact. Measure and report on performance metrics at an executive level.

• Build and scale programmatic account management processes: implement repeatable adoption, churn-risk, optimization, and renewal playbooks that balance scalability with bespoke engagement for strategic accounts.

• Coordinate cross‑functional delivery and escalation management in support of annual growth initiatives.

• Own account health, volume forecasting, and growth goals; align Stripe and customer leadership on success metrics.

• Scale learnings from Key Accounts to other GTM and product teams across Stripe.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 15+ years in customer-facing roles with at least 8+ years leading Strategic Customer Success, Account Management, or related teams.

• Experience in payments, or fintech; familiarity with Stripe products is a plus.

• Proven experience managing a small portfolio of strategic large customers

• Independent, energetic leader with a proven track record of driving organizational change across cross-functional stakeholders and whole-team environments to deliver strong outcomes.

• Strong programmatic and strategic skills: account planning, project management, stakeholder mapping, and executive engagement.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with CRM/CSM tooling and data platforms (Salesforce, Gainsight, Looker or other BI tools).

• Prior experience in a high‑growth, matrixed organization.

title: Cyber Security Engineer (5462)
description:
The Cyber Security Engineer will provide security engineering, compliance, and risk management support for cloud-based systems aligned with NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, and DoD IL4-6 requirements. The role will advise partners and customers navigating government security requirements while supporting authorization, audit readiness, and continuous monitoring activities. A key focus will be improving compliance efficiency through GRC platforms, APIs, scripts, cloud-native services, and automation for evidence collection, control validation, documentation, reporting, and remediation tracking. This position is remote supporting a Herndon, VA based team.

Essential Skills

• Provide cybersecurity engineering and compliance support for FedRAMP and DoD-authorized cloud environments, including IL4-6.
• Advise partners and customers on federal and DoD security requirements, authorization strategies, control implementation, and audit readiness.
• Develop, review, and maintain authorization documentation, including SSPs, SAPs, SARs, POA&Ms, FedRAMP appendices, policies, and supporting evidence.
• Support system authorization and reauthorization activities across FedRAMP/RMF, including gap assessments, control validation, evidence development, and remediation planning.
• Leverage GRC platforms, APIs, scripts, and automation to streamline compliance workflows, evidence collection, documentation updates, control testing, and reporting.
• Develop repeatable and auditable processes that reduce manual compliance effort and improve the accuracy and consistency of authorization artifacts.
• Collaborate with cloud engineering and DevOps teams to design, implement, and validate security controls across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.
• Review system changes and significant change requests to assess security impact, identify documentation updates, and maintain authorization boundaries.
• Coordinate with system owners, engineers, 3PAOs, Authorizing Officials, and government stakeholders to address findings and support authorization outcomes.
• Support continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, POA&M updates, remediation tracking, and recurring compliance deliverables.
• Evaluate security tooling and data sources to identify opportunities for automated control validation and compliance reporting.
• Track evolving federal cybersecurity requirements and translate them into practical technical and operational actions.

Required Skills & Experience

• Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills with a focus on secure and compliant outcomes.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to advise partners, customers, engineers, and government stakeholders.
• Ability to translate federal security requirements into practical technical controls and operational processes.
• U.S. citizenship with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret or higher security clearance.
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Five or more years of cybersecurity experience, including at least three years supporting federal cloud security engineering, information assurance, RMF, or ISSO functions.
• Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, FedRAMP Moderate and High, DoD IL4-6 overlays, RMF, and related federal compliance frameworks.
• Experience developing and maintaining SSPs, POA&Ms, SARs, policies, control evidence, and other authorization artifacts.
• Experience supporting authorization planning, gap assessments, audit readiness, control implementation, and remediation activities.
• Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or hybrid cloud environments, including IAM, encryption, logging, configuration management, and security monitoring.
• Experience using GRC platforms, APIs, scripting, or automation to improve compliance and security workflows.
• Familiarity with tools such as eMASS, Paramify, Nessus/Tenable, Splunk, Prisma Clou

If being a part of a tight-knit organization that operates in some of the most advanced technology environments around the world sounds like a dream job, NTI might be the right fit for you! With the perks of a large organization, NTI remains true to its roots as a home-grown company with an open door culture that welcomes new ideas and encourages professional growth. We set you on the right path with careful onboarding and thorough training programs that prepare you for success in your role and beyond.

THE OPPORTUNITY

National Technologies is seeking a Director of National Labor Coordination to lead enterprise-wide planning, visibility, and allocation of field labor resources. This leader will create a national view of current and future labor demand and ensure the right people are positioned on the right projects at the right time.

Serving as the central coordination point for traveling field labor, this role works across programs, markets, project teams, and operations leadership to anticipate manpower needs before they become project emergencies. The role brings labor demand, employee capabilities, leadership needs, timing, geography, and future assignments together into one national strategy.

WHAT YOU WILL LEAD

• Maintain a forward-looking national labor-demand forecast across active and upcoming projects.

• Maintain visibility into available and committed field resources, including employees approaching demobilization and their next assignments.

• Coordinate mobilizations, demobilizations, transfers, and future assignments across projects, programs, markets, and geographic regions.

• Develop and maintain a comprehensive field skills registry covering employee experience, certifications, technical strengths, leadership capability, customer experience, travel availability, and project history.

• Match employee capabilities to project requirements, looking beyond job classifications alone.

• Identify future labor shortages, surpluses, and capability gaps before they affect project execution.

• Coordinate staffing requirements with project, program, and operations leadership.

• Manage critical traveling personnel as national organizational resources rather than isolated market resources.

• Forecast future recruiting and manpower requirements and coordinate leadership succession needs with National Labor Development.

• Provide executive leadership with labor forecasts, utilization information, risk assessments, and resource recommendations.

• Develop standardized manpower-request and forecasting processes, and challenge unsupported or excessive requests.

• Reduce unnecessary dependence on external labor through stronger internal resource planning.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success in this role will be reflected in:

• Accurate national labor forecasts.

• Critical positions filled when required.

• Fewer emergency staffing requests.

• Improved utilization of internal employees.

• Reduced unnecessary use of external labor.

• Stronger skill-to-project matching.

• Greater visibility into future labor demand.

• Fewer resource conflicts between markets and programs.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Significant experience in construction operations, workforce planning, field operations, labor coordination, or large-project staffing.

• Strong understanding of construction labor requirements and field-leadership structures.

• Experience coordinating labor across multiple projects, markets, or geographic regions.

• The ability to evaluate employee capabilities beyond job classifications alone.

• Strong planning, forecasting, organizational, and analytical skills.

• The ability to manage competing priorities and resolve resource conflicts.

ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Hi, I'm Mariot, I lead Engineering here at Motorway. We're around 70 engineers across product teams, building the marketplace and all services around that handles hundreds of vehicle transactions every day. We care about delivering value to the business, getting the architecture engineering sound, keeping the production bar high, and being early and deliberate about the technology we adopt.

We have been early adopters of GenAI for software engineering, we've built a reputation for that, and we'd like to keep earning it. AI is enabling us to deliver faster at a much higher quality software while easing the maintenance of our existing services.

- Identify new services we could adopt to continuously improve our reliability and ability to build new services and features at pace for the business.

- Share internally good practices on software engineering at the edge and usage of AWS services, including continuously updating technical recommendations for humans and agents.

You'll represent Motorway on stage at external events and in the wider engineering community, and you'll set the standard for how engineers here present their work internally.

You'll also lead on our adoption of AI for software engineering. We give engineers access to the latest models through Kiro, and we want someone who can define what good looks like when domain depth, AI-enabled breadth, and rigorous evaluation all have to work together.

description:

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

As Product Counsel, you will be a hands-on legal partner to the teams building Claude for consumers and businesses. You'll work across Claude's apps, subscriptions, growth programs and enterprise offerings, moving to wherever the need is greatest. You'll learn from experienced product lawyers, get close to the product quickly, and take on more ownership as you go. • Build the dealer crosswalk that links each dealer to its Google Ads account, Meta account, Salesforce record and inventory feed, with the attributes the platform filters and routes on, a standing exception report and automatic onboarding of new enrollments. Never resolve an ambiguous match by guessing.

• Ingest daily VIN-level inventory from Snowflake, offers from S3 feeds and an offers API, and manufacturer enrollment files, with freshness and completeness checks that stop downstream work on stale data.

• Agree the data contracts with the client's data team in Sprint 0, and use the shared contracts the platform pod publishes for inventory, offers and incentives where they cover the same feeds.

• Build pacing detection: current-day spend from the ad platforms, month-end projection from remaining eligible days, and flags a strategist can understand.

• Build the Incentive Sync engine: offers and their expiry in one approval, validated per account against manufacturer rules, removed exactly once on expiry.

• Model manufacturer rules, allowed values and model lineups as versioned, effective-dated data, and supply dealer and inventory data to the playbook renderer and to inventory-driven campaign selection.

Prove and move the book

• Build wave orchestration and the evidence pipeline: fourteen-day before-and-after aggregates, ID checks, settings diffs, tracking audit and zero-spend checks, assembled into a scorecard the client signs.

• Produce the data for the pilot wave in month five. The client uses that evidence to decide whether to give notice to its current tool.

• Run the data side of five production waves: bind every adopted campaign to its budget, carry over settings held only in the current tool, audit and fix inherited tracking parameters, and calibrate pacing on live spend.

Run it and hand it over

• Run production operations during the migration: observability tuning, incident response, API quota monitoring and rollback drills, coordinated with the platform pod's on-call for the shared environments.

• Hand pipelines, runbooks, environments and data contracts to the client's teams, and confirm the handover by having them run it.

• Write decision records, runbooks and documentation the client's data team can work from, and pair with their engineers throughout.

Because the team is small, also

• Run the data working sessions with the client's data team and Salesforce administrators yourself, and leave with written agreements.

• Make reversible data design decisions when the Solutions Architect is unavailable, write them down and bring them for review.

• Prepare the data side of every wave sign-off pack, and act as first responder for data issues during the migration.

• Raise blockers early and in writing, with an impact assessment on schedule, scope or quality.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Introduction to the team: The Magnets team is one of several key research verticals within SandboxAQ’s broader Chemical Simulation group, which uses advanced computational methods, physics-based simulation, and AI to discover and develop novel materials. This group is focused on solving critical materials challenges that matter to U.S. semiconductor manufacturing and industrial resilience.

Within that larger effort, this group is focused on one of the most strategically important materials problems: developing high-performance permanent magnets that reduce or eliminate reliance on neodymium and other rare earth elements and can be produced in the United States. The goal is to create novel magnet formulations that can be manufactured using existing industry processes and equipment, while matching or exceeding the performance of today’s leading NdFeB magnets in demanding applications such as semiconductor equipment, vacuum systems, precision motion devices, and defense technologies.

Introduction to the role: We are looking for a Principal Scientist to lead the scientific direction of the Magnets vertical. This person will define the research strategy and technical roadmap, build and lead a top-tier scientific team, and help shape how computational materials discovery, simulation, and AI are applied to accelerate magnet development.

This leader will work at the intersection of domain science and platform innovation. You will help shape the magnetism-aware LQM and multi-scale modeling strategy in close partnership with our AI simulation platform teams, while also guiding dataset strategy, modeling priorities, and experimental validation to turn cutting-edge research into practical, manufacturable magnet technologies.

You will also serve as a key external scientific representative for the program, working with national labs, manufacturing partners, defense organizations, and equipment companies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the scientific charter and technical roadmap for the Magnets vertical, including phase stability, magnetocrystalline anisotropy, finite-temperature coercivity, and microstructure engineering across Fe- and Co-based intermetallic systems with U.S.-accessible alloying elements.

- IP Engine Management: Oversee the translation of generative design outputs into a robust IP portfolio, ensuring the team owns the most valuable "white space" in substrate chemistry and structural design.

- Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of research scientists, computational/ML scientists, and postdocs; set the scientific bar, run technical reviews, and develop talent toward NewCo readiness.

title: Support & QA Specialist, Tax
description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.
A Different Kind Of Job Description
At Filed , we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.
What's hard about this job
Bugs don't arrive with instructions. A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it.
Your ticket is the fix's starting point. Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time.
The pace is fast. Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built.
It isn't fixed until you've checked. You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke.
Why it might be the best career move you'll make
You'll sit between customers and engineering. Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built.
Your work ships. A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day.
You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles.
We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.
What You'll Own

• Reproducing customer-reported issues step by step, inside Filed and the tax software firms already use

• Writing clear, complete Linear tickets with exact steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots and sample data, so engineers can act straight away

• Answering customer tickets quickly and clearly in our support inbox

• Troubleshooting technical issues and finding workarounds that keep firms moving

• Verifying fixes before they go back to the customer, and regression testing after releases

• Spotting patterns across tickets and flagging them before they spread

Your Hard Skillset

• Hands-on QA or software testing experience: you've reproduced bugs and written them up for an engineering team

• Customer support experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk

• A tax background, either at a tax or accounting firm, at a tax software company, or preparing returns yourself. You don't need to be a preparer, but you should know your way around a return.

• Familiarity with at least one major tax platform, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake or GoSystem

• Bonus if you've used Linear or Jira, browser developer tools or screen recording to capture issues

Your Soft Skillset

• Methodical: you change one thing at a time until you find what breaks

• Clear writing: your tickets and replies leave no room for confusion

• Curious: you want to know why something broke, not just that it did

• Calm and patient with customers who are under deadline pressure

• You take ownership and follow a problem through to the fix

Who This Suits

• People who enjoy hunting down a problem more than answering the same question twice

• Support professionals who want to move into QA and product

• Tax professionals who want to move into tech without leaving their expertise

title: Senior Software Engineer - Builder Platform
description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Join our Builder Platform Team as a Senior Software Engineer. Our mission is to empower a company of builders by delivering a frictionless, standardized, and governed platform for agents, workflows, and core engineering tools. We operate Temporal as customer zero: we partner directly with teams across the company to run their real work on the platform, measure the productivity it unlocks, and feed what we learn back into Temporal’s products and an open-source frameworks our customers can adopt.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Develop and operate our Agent Platform for deploying, running, evaluating, governing, and improving agents and agentic workflows.

title: Director, Communications, Media & Journalism
description:
Join phData , a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises.

We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results.

Why phData ?

• Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year - 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year

• AWS Premier Tier Services Partner - the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network

• 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)

• 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status

• 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year

• Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network

• #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications

• 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more)

• Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM

About the Role
Most companies in data and AI sound the same. The same launch recaps, the same borrowed talking points, the same claims no one checked. This role exists so phData doesn't. You turn what our R&D experts and executives know into original, fact-checked journalism that reporters quote, analysts cite, and buyers trust. You are one person working with roughly 10 subject-matter experts and executives, and you don't have a team to hide behind. If you do this poorly, phData publishes content that is forgettable at best and wrong at worst, in a market where credibility is the whole game.
About You
Read this section like a mirror, not a checklist. Some of it is meant to make you nod. Some of it is meant to make you uncomfortable. Both reactions are useful, to you and to us.

• You've killed a story you loved because one source wouldn't confirm it. You didn't publish and hope.

• You've told a senior executive their idea wasn't original enough to run, and kept the relationship.

• Journalist first. You report, interview, verify, and edit like someone whose name is on the byline. You consider "good enough to publish" a failure of standards, not a deadline.

• Quiet ownership. Your best work goes out under an SME's or executive's name. You are fine with that, and you still defend its quality as if it were yours.

• Judgment over volume. You pick one flagship idea a quarter and say no to the rest. You don't measure yourself by how much you shipped.

• Translator. You can sit with an R&D lead who is explaining agent orchestration, ask the question that exposes the real insight, and then explain it to a reporter in two sentences.

• Relationship builder. You earn attention from reporters and analysts by being useful and accurate, not by pitching harder.

title: Product Manager, Inference Platform
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

PRODUCT AT BASETEN

Baseten is building a new cloud for AI. Our ambition is to make inference, training, and agent execution part of one coherent platform, and to shape how the next generation of AI products gets built. Product decisions here reach from the economics of GPU infrastructure to the abstractions developers build on every day.

We’re hiring builders and tastemakers with the ambition to help create that future. You should bring a strong point of view about what should exist, the taste to make complex technology feel simple, and the technical judgment to build it alongside engineers, researchers, and designers. You’ll work directly with customers and forward deployed teams, turn emerging capabilities into new possibilities for developers, and carry an idea from early conviction through to production and adoption.

THE ROLE

Make AI inference faster, smarter, and more efficient at scale.

Making AI models faster and cheaper is one of the most important engineering challenges in the industry. But a faster runtime alone isn't enough. Customers need to understand what improved, whether it works for their models, and how to take advantage of it in production.

We're looking for a deeply technical Product Manager to work alongside our inference engineers and researchers, turning advances in model serving and performance into capabilities customers can confidently adopt.

You'll help bridge the gap between cutting-edge systems engineering and real-world production workloads.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Work with inference engineering and research teams to bring new performance capabilities to customers.

- Translate advances in batching, caching, quantization, speculative decoding, and serving architectures into useful product features.

- Define benchmarks and evaluations that demonstrate meaningful improvements in latency, throughput, quality, and cost.

- Understand customer workloads and help prioritize the optimizations that will have the greatest impact.

- Make performance features easier to configure, evaluate, and adopt in production.

- Help customers understand tradeoffs across hardware, model configurations, autoscaling, and routing.

- Partner with engineering on release readiness, compatibility, and regression testing so customers can trust new capabilities.

REQUIREMENTS

- Experience building and shipping AI/ML products or infrastructure, particularly where performance, scalability, or production behavior mattered.

- A technical background in software engineering, ML engineering, research, or equivalent hands-on experience.

- Strong understanding of model serving architectures, GPU economics, and latency, throughput, quality, and cost tradeoffs.

- Experience working closely with researchers or infrastructure engineers to bring technically complex capabilities into production.

- A rigorous approach to benchmarking, experimentation, and performance measurement.

- Strong product judgment and the ability to translate deep technical work into clear customer value.

NICE TO HAVE

- Hands-on experience with PyTorch, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar technologies.

- Experience with open-source inference projects, model optimization, or ML systems research.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Customers can take advantage of Baseten's latest inference optimizations without becoming experts in the underlying run

Security Analytics Engineer
Role Overview
The Security Analytics Engineer designs, operates, and continuously improves the organization's security telemetry, analytics, detection engineering, and observability capabilities. The role provides the data and analytics foundation used by Security Operations while extending traditional SIEM capabilities through behavioral analytics, automation, AI-assisted correlation, and observability for autonomous and agentic systems.

• Develop and tune behavioral detections, correlation logic, dashboards, and alerting strategies.

• Translate threat intelligence, incidents, vulnerability findings, and offensive-security results into improved detection content.

• Build observability for AI agents and autonomous workflows, including identity, tool usage, execution activity, and security-relevant behavior.

• Apply AI-assisted techniques to log analysis, correlation, anomaly detection, enrichment, and investigation support.

• Automate telemetry management and security workflows while maintaining appropriate human oversight and explainability.

• Optimize SIEM and related systems platform reliability, data quality, performance, retention, and cost.

Qualifications

• Experience engineering SIEM, security analytics, detection, observability, or large-scale telemetry systems.

• Strong knowledge of logging, event correlation, normalization, enrichment, and security data pipelines.

• Experience developing detections, behavioral analytics, or correlation logic.

• Experience integrating security telemetry from diverse enterprise and cloud environments.

• Scripting or software-development experience and familiarity with APIs and Infrastructure-as-Code.

• Understanding of modern cloud and distributed architectures.

• Familiarity with security telemetry standards, MITRE ATT&CK, AI-assisted analytics, or observability of AI/agentic systems is preferred.

description:
Overview
Who We Are
Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform-bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.
Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.
Responsibilities
Case Management Social Services Coordinator (Level I)
Ready to guide members through their toughest moments and turn complex needs into clear plans?
Why This Role Matters
Some of our members are facing the hardest stretch of their lives: a catastrophic diagnosis, a hospital discharge with no plan, or a pile of needs no one has connected. You’re the person who picks up the phone and makes sense of it all. By assessing the whole person, building care plans that fit, and linking members to the right providers and community resources, you improve outcomes while keeping the total cost of care in check. Your documentation and quality work also keep us ready for URAC and NCQA review. When you do this well, members get real support and the organization earns the trust that keeps our programs strong.
What You’ll Actually Do

•
Guide members by phone and virtually: Manage short- and long-term cases in line with company policies, established guidelines, and industry criteria, with guidance available when complex barriers arise.

•
Assess the whole person: Conduct biopsychosocial assessments covering physical, emotional, psychosocial, spiritual, environmental, and financial needs, so every care decision starts with the full picture.

•
Spot risk in the data: Use claims-processing tools to analyze paid claims, identify risk indicators, and determine program eligibility.

•
Build person-centered care plans: Develop individualized plans for standard and catastrophic cases with measurable short- and long-term goals, then monitor interventions, evaluate effectiveness, and document outcomes.

•
Advocate for members: Coordinate resources, support care transitions, and refer members to wellness programs, behavioral health programs, and community-based services so they get quality care and avoid unnecessary costs.

•
Keep the care team connected: Maintain consistent contact with members, caregivers, providers, employers, and the interdisciplinary team throughout the continuum of care.

•
Drive cost-smart outcomes: Implement and document cost-management strategies, including monthly case reviews and cost-avoidance data.

•
Document with precision: Keep accurate, complete records in El Dorado, UM Web/Health Notes, and other required systems, prepare 30-day interval updates for every case-managed member, and maintain site-specific files in line with HIPAA and confidentiality rules.

•
Stay audit-ready: Meet URAC and NCQA requirements, pass external audits, complete annual trainings, and hit daily, weekly, and monthly productivity, quality, and turnaround standards.

•
Strengthen how we work: Support department operations and implementations, participate in team meetings and case discussions, and bring forward ideas for process improvement.

• Working knowledge of URAC and NCQA standards and HIPAA confidentiality requirements

• Knowledge of medical claims and ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding

• Foundational clinical judgment, social work principles, and motivational interviewing
